title: skill.state
description: Durable per-node skill state document written by the FinanceCheque child-proxy harness to ~/.fcukproxy/skills/skill.state.json. Each OTA-managed skill component is tracked here so skills can resume across restarts instead of cold-starting.

updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last state write.

skills.description: Map of OTA-managed skill component name -> skill record.

version.description: Installed skill version from the OTA manifest.

enabled.description: Whether the skill is enabled on this node.

status.description: Last known lifecycle status: idle | ok | error | running.

lastRun.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last run, or null.

lastError.description: Last error message on failure, or null.

updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last update to this record.
